recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is needed for FHIR-49972 unless a future work group decision changes the vital-signs body-weight unit policy.
issue_request: FHIR-49972 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 asking to add the UCUM avoirdupois ounce code to the ucum-bodyweight value set as part of the FHIR-27004 vital-signs unit work.
initial_application: Jira records applied git 90f6f81f6c, which added '[oz_av]' to source/observation/valueset-ucum-bodyweight.xml and source/observation/valueset-ucum-vitals-common.xml. Follow-up commit 8515a4fcf4 added missing '[oz_av]' references in the bodyweight profile summaries and binding description.
additional_context: FHIR-27004 is the parent vital-signs unit issue and was ultimately resolved by adding oz_av rather than relaxing the body-weight profile requirement. OO minutes on 2025-03-07 record an 8-0-0 motion to add oz_av for body weight in the R6 ballot. Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, and related no-change issues FHIR-31919 and FHIR-39153 do not conflict with this core value-set source.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative source already contains '[oz_av]' in both value sets and the bodyweight profile binding description, so any source edit would be redundant.
